text:
marie: heads-up: redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total spiked in prod-rw-us-east-1 ~10:04 UTC. residency dropped ~30%. any idea what changed?

doug: can you paste the exact queries / panel you were looking at?

marie: yeah — pulled these:
```
rate(redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])
redwood_kv_cache_residency_percentage
redwood_kv_cache_hit_rate
```
also saw per-shard evictions skewed toward shard-3.

vikram: that lines up with the batching heuristics rollout at 09:45 (PR #2345). we increased max_batch_wait_ms to reduce small-batch penalties — could affect KV residency if requests bundle differently. cc @marie

elena: could also be fragmentation + reuse issue for long-context sessions. do we have a fragmentation metric? iirc we had an internal gauge but it's not on the dashboard.

ash: (sorry out of sync) quick thought — if a small subset of sessions keep extending context, their KV entries grow and push out others; eviction counts go up even if hit_rate looks ok overall.

marie: confirmed: correlating with user-session token lengths — top 10 sessions by token count hold ~40% of active KV entries.

doug: can we get promql for per-model/per-session residency? something like: 
```
sum by(model) (redwood_kv_cache_residency_entries{env="prod"})
sum by(session_id) (redwood_kv_cache_entries{env="prod"}) |> topk(10, sum)
```
(adapt as needed; session labels may be sampled)

elena: i'd add a fragmentation ratio:
```
(redwood_kv_cache_allocated_bytes - redwood_kv_cache_resident_bytes) / redwood_kv_cache_allocated_bytes
```
would help detect slow-release memory/holes.

ash: +1. also we should surface eviction reason counters: 
`redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total{reason="capacity"}` vs `{reason="stale"}`.

marie: current panels: hit rate, residency %, total evictions. missing: per-shard eviction rate, fragmentation ratio, eviction_by_reason, top-sessions by entries, and long-context rental metric.

vikram: i ran a flamegraph on the runtime around the spike — not CPU but a lot of memcpy during KV compaction / rebalancing between shard-2/3. attaching snippet: 
```
# profiler sample (top frames)
memcpy
kv_shard_compact
kv_insert_or_reuse
```
Suggests the runtime tried to consolidate entries (maybe after policy change).

sre-bot: ALERT: KV_EVICTION_RATE_HIGH prod-rw-us-east-1 fired at 2025-11-04T10:05:03Z (threshold 50/min).

elena: action items i can pick up: add fragmentation gauge, eviction_by_reason, and per-shard panels in Grafana. will add Annotations for the 09:45 rollout so we can visualize.

ash: mitigation option: reduce per-session max_entries from 100k -> 60k for a canary subset and see if eviction rate drops. also consider age-based TTL for entries beyond X tokens.

marie: good call. i'll do a canary for 10% of traffic with lowered per-session quota and enable the new eviction reason tagging. will track these queries: 
```
# 1m eviction rate per shard
sum by (shard) (rate(redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total[1m]))
# overall hitrate (5m)
avg_over_time(redwood_kv_cache_hit_rate[5m])
# residency by model
sum by (model) (redwood_kv_cache_resident_entries)
```

doug: for alerts, consider: eviction_rate_per_shard > 30/m for 3m OR residency drop >20% in 5m. also bubble up top-sessions panel so SRE can drill.

elena: i'll add panels + alerts and a compact dashboard layout: top row global KPIs (hit_rate, residency, evictions), second row per-shard, third row long-context explorers.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: kv-session-quota-canary -> 10% (deploy id: canary-20251104-09:58).

marie: thanks all — i'll monitor for 30m and report back. if evictions don't subside we'll roll back the batching heuristic change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

vikram: ping if you want me to revert the batching PR quickly.

marie: noted — will post results here. thanks! :raised_hands:
